title: Conditional κ = 0.001703713039257905: a sixth #2436-type alias (helper 656 borrows lender 88) on the entrance-raised T74 words
body:
## Summary

Conditional κ = **0.001703713039257905554028664309530044147226674332780064603003…** (3046 decimals; the exact value is `kappa` in `research/gmx-t74-borrow43-handoff/outer/OUTER-CLAIM.json`, SHA-256 of the decimal string `9bafb1ff73763ecabddd9544efc36aa6157de404d482150215b611ccdf7e58d0`). This package adds a sixth PR2436-type (tekuuu) alias to our PR2474 words: helper 656 borrows lender 88 (partner 80; restoration gate add 88 += 1/2 * 80 before B1125; Gaussian G columns from the PR2436-type pair), lifting four more targets (141, 171, 185, 196) to line 30 and adding two more centre COPY splits. It stacks on the fifth alias (helper 637 borrowing retired source 31), PR2436's four lifted-target aliases (helpers 640, 641, 642 and 644 borrowing from lenders 33, 55, 74 and 85) and our entrance-raised words of PR2435/PR2447. The whole stack rests on PR2322's handoff construction (Vlado Vojdanovski) and our PR2312 words. This is not PR2436's whole construction: our word has 428 helpers per call. New in this package, by Jeremy Kothe (jeremykothe2), with AI assistance: the stacking of the sixth alias, its exact pricing, the audit of both words (forward and dual, with tamper controls on the new reads and the warp), and an exact owner fill for the 428-helper words (leftover idle {1:21858, 3:7308, 5:34, 6:1, 8:554, 16:40, 30:1, 32:7, 48:25752}; same call order, windows and plan; every window, bin, helper and family rule checked literally); local profile {1:2365, 2:632, 3:325, 4:120, 5:32, 7:6, 8:2}, width inventory {4:33, 5:8, 7:62, 8:85, 9:240} per call. Hardening stages added: the cut-centre guard of PR2478 (mdumitrean) and the helper-index guard of PR2508 (ywz65), each with a negative control. Also carried: private cleanup-buffer stock accounting (PR2309, PR2315), the pooled-slot time binding (PR2301, PR1959), the entrance-width binding stage and the 1e-3000 endpoints with the fixed-grid-maximum outer kappa C - 1/F - B (PR2180 / PR2161; PR2168). Conditional final kappa = 0.0017037130392579055540286643095300441472…(3046 digits) (supplier strict-assembly kappa 0.0017008153379892035062517940545086349285…(2995 digits)). It exceeds PR2474 (our previous package, kappa 0.0017036763879936764890...) by 3.66513E-8 (exact gate in verify_release.py). grid_digits 2995, margin_digits 3005, bootstrap_steps 1116; 63 strict inequalities, 17 rejecting controls.

## Verification

Fresh checkout of `8bb4f1c73e61d571ae82e5814eb6dd5e4b9b8b3a` (text-only follow-up to `113c427bf6abe2572184621ebfa00ce7cdf06c46`: README prints PR2474's kappa as the predecessor's; alias 656 credited as our new work using PR2436's mechanism; kappa unchanged). Manifest: `46fb07602a18b3f1115e30e18d79e16f6e7cf70688cbfc7bc6b16f9f46d43492`.
PASS package manifest: 448 files

Supplier: the package's own unchanged `verify.py` (retained PR1297 provider and parent admission, owner reconstruction, parent lift, strict T74 admission, geometry controls): `PASS_T74_EXACT_FILL_COMPLETE_FINITE_ADMISSION`, native reuse {'base': 'e8e6e78ff7422275c38324499e1f33fb2ecd30de9503aef2b8f1ee80d8c4df8e', 'extra': '7b0e9fbda32749aabc7e156d9fe09bceb0624a178628fe69e5dfea783462f905'}; its complex endpoint 170371303925790555402866430953... brackets the ledger's b = 1703713039257905554028664309530044147226…(3078 digits)/1000000000000000000000000000000000000000…(3081 digits). Outer (PR1673 capped phase-cell fusion): regenerated exact ledger (63 strict inequalities: the 62 retained rows plus the explicit main-binding row gaussian_above_main, the fixed-grid maximum kappa = C - 1/F - B asserted, 17 rejecting controls incl. the old g-factor union row, the old linear and old-theta chirp guards, the old 2*beta tag test, epsilon at 1 or at the r0 slack and beta outside its window, larger endpoint rejected by the native moment), independent balance derivation, the exact union-schedule simulation, the (retained, not used for kappa) structured-boundary displacement-rank check, the gauge-free identity/symbol/circuit checks, PR1786's finite prime/underflow controls and 19 exact evidence replays all pass. Conditional kappa 0.0017037130392579055540286643095300441472…(3046 digits) (union schedule outer/UNION-SCHEDULE.md; explicit Strassen boundary tau=45/16 (the structured boundary of outer/STRUCTURED-BOUNDARY.md is not used); gauge-free interiors outer/GAUGEFREE-INTERIORS.md; fine source-prime padding PR1786 at the free point epsilon=1-(1025/1024)e-3080, outer/FINE-PADDING-COMPOSITION.md; fixed-grid maximum of PR2180/PR2161 (dataisfire), outer/PROOF-GRID-MAX.md; exact-integer coarse exponential PR2168/PR2184 (dataisfire) at the one 3000-digit rejection call).

Full package-owned verification passed in 201.9 seconds on the new head (PASS_RELEASE, kappa identical). The fresh receipt binds the exact package manifest and score.

See `research/gmx-t74-borrow43-handoff/README.md` for reproduction commands and proof qualifications.
